_comment: What the character pack offers and how it may be dressed. Read by stagekit.cast, tools/plan.py (period check) and `clip.py cast`. After a new pack release or a new character: `python tools/cast_registry.py merge <notes.json>` then `python tools/clip.py cast --rescan` (parts, colours, height, headwear come from the pack; looks, era, group, stand_in, adapt, adapt_note, props, body are written by hand).

eras.east_asia_feudal: feudal Japan, imperial China and Korea
eras.fantasy: storybook world built from medieval and renaissance pieces

AdultMan.looks: man, curly brown hair, big moustache, plain belted tunic: peasant, farmer, miller, innkeeper; dressed up he is a merchant or noble

victorian.note: A labourer in a smock. Add top_hat and buttons for a gentleman.

ancient.note: A plain belted tunic works for most of the ancient world.

Alien.looks: small friendly alien, lavender skin, big bald round head, big dark eyes, two antennae with ball tips that sway, sage green flight suit with a stand collar, chest pocket and belt, dark boots: visitor from space, space pilot, mascot
Alien.adapt_note: recolor the skin green for the classic little green man; recolor the suit silver or orange for a space-crew look; hide the Antenna parts for a bald humanoid

body.notes: standard body: walks, sits and holds like anyone; the two antennae (Antenna.L/R and their tips) sway by themselves

Alien.decisions: the sheet shows no prop, a toy-like ray gun was written; antennae wiggle 7 degrees every 0.9 s in opposite phase; slightly shorter than the adults (1.53 m to the head top) with a bigger head (R 0.285)

Apothecary.looks: woman in a white mob cap over centre-parted dark-brown hair, long teal dress with a white collar and cuffs, cream waist apron on a leather waistband: apothecary, herbalist, healer, housekeeper, maid, cook, innkeeper's wife, nurse of the period
Apothecary.adapt_note: hide Apron for a townswoman; hide Cap and Cap_Frill for bare hair; recolor the dress brown or grey for a servant, black for a widow or a governess
Apothecary.decisions: A-line dress without a fitted waist (the belt and apron give the waist); the cap is one puffed shape with a frill band, simpler than the sheet.

Archaeologist.looks: young woman, brown centre-parted hair with a long braid over one shoulder, olive shirt with rolled sleeves, tan field vest with pockets, brown trousers and boots: archaeologist, explorer, field scientist, naturalist, safari guide
Archaeologist.adapt_note: hide Vest_Pocket.* and Vest_Flap.* and recolor the vest for a plain waistcoat; recolor shirt and vest khaki for a ranger or zoo keeper; wear a straw_hat for a dig in the sun
Archaeologist.decisions: the sheet shows her holding a notebook: made it a prop (field journal) and added a trowel as the clearer signature tool; vest drawn closed with a centre line instead of open; braid hangs from the head (it swings with head tilts)

Astronaut.looks: young adult man with short dark hair in a white space suit with orange bands on the arms and shins, grey neck ring, chest control panel, round helmet with a light blue inside around the face, white gloves and boots: astronaut, cosmonaut, space-station crew, test pilot in a pressure suit
Astronaut.adapt_note: hide Helmet, Helmet_Inside, Helmet_EarCap.* for the astronaut with the helmet off (hold a helmet prop if needed); recolor the suit orange for a launch suit or the stripes blue for another crew member
Astronaut.decisions: the helmet is a white ring with a light tint drawn BEHIND the head layers, so the face, expressions and lip sync stay fully visible in all three views (an open visor rather than a glass front). Hands recoloured to the suit white as gloves, with grey wrist cuffs riding the forearms; stripes ride the upper arms and shins. Thicker limbs and bigger boots than the template for the suit. The flag prop is plain orange with a white band: no national flag.

Baby.looks: bald baby in a blue onesie

Baker.looks: woman, black hair under a cream headscarf knotted at the side, long green dress with a white collar and rolled sleeves, white waist apron: baker, cook, kitchen maid, farmer's wife, market woman, innkeeper's wife
Baker.adapt_note: hide Scarf and Scarf_Knot_* for a bare-headed village woman; hide Apron and Apron_Tie for a plain peasant dress; recolor the dress grey or brown for a servant
Baker.decisions: sleeves drawn rolled to the elbow instead of long with white cuffs (reads as kitchen work, fewer parts); the scarf knot sits at the side of the head in front and 3q and at the nape in profile

BalletDancer.looks: slim young woman, light-brown hair parted in the middle with a bun, lilac long-sleeved leotard, short stiff cream tutu, pale tights, lilac slippers with crossed ribbons: ballet dancer, ballerina, music-box figure, dance student
BalletDancer.adapt_note: hide Tutu and Waistband for a gymnast or acrobat; recolor leotard and slippers white for a swan, black for the rival; recolor the tutu pink for a child's recital
BalletDancer.decisions: tutu is a stiff flared skirt part on the torso (not a robe), shorter than the knee-length skirt of the sheet as the brief asks; slim limbs (LIMB_B) and smaller hands; no signature prop (the sheet figure holds nothing)

Barber.looks: man, brown skin, short black curls, blue shirt with rolled sleeves, white bib apron with blue stripes and a bow at the waist, navy trousers: barber, butcher, grocer, shopkeeper, soda-fountain clerk
Barber.adapt_note: hide Apron_Stripe_* for a plain white apron (cook, grocer); hide Apron, Apron_Tie, Apron_Strap.*, Apron_Bow* for a man in shirt sleeves; recolor the stripes red for a butcher
Barber.decisions: no prop on the sheet: scissors and comb written as his signature props; apron ends above the knee and is rigid on the torso (it does not fold when he sits, like the Barista's)

Barista.looks: young woman, brown hair in a top bun, blue shirt, tan bib apron, dark trousers

medieval.note: A plain shirt, bib apron and dark hose read as a servant, cook, gardener or innkeeper once the modern blue is replaced with an earth colour. Hide Hair_Bun under a hat.

victorian.note: A shop girl or maid as she is.

BeachGirl.looks: woman, wavy auburn hair, flowered shirt, shorts, sandals

Blacksmith.looks: big bearded man, dark messy hair, full beard and moustache, grey shirt with rolled sleeves and bare forearms, long leather apron with a neck strap, boots: blacksmith, farrier, armourer, tanner, butcher
Blacksmith.adapt_note: recolor the apron white for a butcher or a baker; hide Apron, Apron_Strap.*, Apron_Tie for a bearded labourer or dock worker
Blacksmith.decisions: thicker arms and bigger hands than the template so he reads as strong; beard built on the Mechanic model but fuller; hammer and tongs are my choice (nothing held on the sheet)

Boxer.looks: young woman, dark hair in a top bun, maroon short-sleeved top and shorts with cream trim, big maroon boxing gloves, white socks, dark boots: boxer, fighter, athlete, gym trainer
Boxer.adapt_note: hide Glove.*, Glove_Thumb.* and Glove_Cuff.* for a runner, gym trainer or athlete with free hands (needed for any shot where she holds something); recolor top and shorts blue for the opponent
Boxer.decisions: gloves are costume parts on the hand.L / hand.R bones over the normal hands (cuffs on the forearms); they cover whatever the hand grips, so hide them for hold shots; the championship belt is carried or held up with both hands; wrist wraps of the sheet became the glove cuffs

Boy.looks: boy, spiky auburn hair, freckles, green tunic: a child, an apprentice, a page

victorian.note: A street boy as he is.

BusDriver.looks: older man, grey side hair and grey moustache, navy peaked cap with a gold badge, light blue uniform shirt, dark tie, belt, navy trousers: bus driver, tram or train driver, chauffeur, ticket inspector, doorman, postman
BusDriver.adapt_note: recolor shirt white and cap black for a chauffeur or a ship's officer; hide Cap, Cap_Band, Cap_Visor and Cap_Badge for an off-duty older man in shirt and tie
BusDriver.decisions: prop is the steering wheel (the sheet figure holds nothing); an older man's slightly shorter stride

Butler.looks: older man, grey swept-back hair, black tailcoat with tails, cream waistcoat, white shirt, black bow tie, black trousers and shoes: butler, head waiter, footman, conductor of an orchestra, undertaker, wedding guest
Butler.adapt_note: hide Coat_Tails for a dinner jacket (waiter, groom); recolor the coat dark green or burgundy for a footman in livery; recolor the hair brown for a young waiter
Butler.decisions: 3 cm shorter than the adult men and a slower walk (an older man); the tails are a rigid part on the torso, not a robe (they hang behind the thighs when he sits); no prop on the sheet: a silver tray with a cloche written as his signature prop

Candlemaker.looks: brown-skinned young man, round curly black hair, sage-green shirt with rolled sleeves, long stone-coloured bib apron with one big pocket, brown trousers, dark boots: candlemaker, chandler, potter, baker, shopkeeper, craftsman, workshop apprentice
Candlemaker.adapt_note: hide Apron, Apron_Strap.L/R and Apron_Pocket for a plain villager; recolor the apron leather-brown for a tanner or a smith's helper, white for a baker
Candlemaker.decisions: apron shortened to just below the hips (the sheet's reaches the shins) so it does not hang far below the seat when he sits; it still hangs straight in the sitting 3/4 and side views, like the pack's Barista. Candle is a lit candle without a holder, as on the sheet.

Carpenter.looks: young woman, curly chestnut chin-length hair, tan work shirt with rolled sleeves, leather belt with a brass buckle, blue work trousers, brown boots: carpenter, joiner, builder, farmhand, stable hand, workshop apprentice
Carpenter.adapt_note: wear an apron for a workshop scene; recolor the shirt red-check or blue for a farmhand; wear a flat cap or straw_hat for outdoor work
Carpenter.decisions: the sheet figure is ambiguous: built as a woman on the female template; rolled trouser cuffs and the hammer loop on the belt left out; the mallet is a separate prop

CarriageDriver.looks: man, black-brown top hat, brown side hair, long brown overcoat with darker lapels, grey waistcoat, red neckerchief, grey trousers, brown boots: carriage driver, coachman, cab driver, undertaker's man, street trader, gentleman traveller
CarriageDriver.adapt_note: hide Hat, Hat_Band, Hat_Brim for a bare-headed traveller (the side hair stays, the crown is bald: wear a flat cap instead); recolor the coat black for an undertaker or a banker; hide Neckerchief* for a plainer gentleman
CarriageDriver.decisions: victorian only (the top hat); the whip prop is also tagged age_of_sail; hair is drawn only at the sides because the hat covers the crown; coat drawn closed below the waistcoat with a centre opening line

CasualMan.looks: man in a mustard shirt and jeans

victorian.note: A working man once the jeans are brown or grey wool.

age_of_sail.note: A deckhand or dock worker in a loose shirt.

Chef.looks: adult woman, brown skin, dark curly bob, tall white toque, white double-breasted jacket with six buttons, red neckerchief, grey trousers: chef, cook, baker, kitchen hand, restaurant owner
Chef.adapt_note: hide Toque_Top and Toque_Band for a cook off duty or a waitress; hide Scarf, Scarf_Tail.*, Scarf_Knot and recolor the jacket for a lab worker or pharmacist; wear an apron for a baker
Chef.decisions: skin tone taken from the sheet as its own colour (fc_cf_skin, lighter than the pack's skin_brown). Ears left out (hair covers them). Ladle chosen as the prop (the sheet figure holds nothing). The toque and double-breasted whites are 19th century onward, so no earlier eras.

ChimneySweep.looks: boy, grey flat cap over curly brown hair, soot smudges on the cheeks, grey shirt with rolled sleeves, dark waistcoat, red neckerchief, dark trousers and boots: chimney sweep, street urchin, newsboy, errand boy, pickpocket, factory boy
ChimneySweep.adapt_note: hide Soot.L and Soot.R for a clean errand boy or a newsboy; hide Kerchief and Kerchief_Knot; recolor the waistcoat and cap for a schoolboy of the period
ChimneySweep.decisions: built as a child (the sheet draws all ten the same size): the Boy's head and leg numbers, arm_len 0.33 instead of 0.38 so the hands hang at the hips on the T_A-style body. Soot smudges added for the read. Ears off, big curly side mops under the cap.

Cobbler.looks: old woman, grey curly hair with a bun, round glasses, dark-red blouse with rolled sleeves, brown leather bib apron with a pocket, long plum skirt: cobbler, shoemaker, grandmother, seamstress, weaver, shopkeeper, village elder, storyteller
Cobbler.adapt_note: hide Apron, Apron_Strap.L/R and Apron_Pocket for a grandmother in blouse and skirt; hide the Glasses_* parts for an earlier period (round wire glasses fit renaissance onward); recolor the apron white or linen for a baker or a cook
Cobbler.decisions: 4 cm shorter than the adult template (old). No hammer: the sheet shows only the boot. The boot prop is drawn a little oversized so it reads in the hand.

CourtScribe.looks: old man, grey side hair and a full grey beard, dark-red soft cap, long dark-red robe open over a tan under-robe with buttons, white collar: scribe, clerk, scholar, notary, judge, merchant, advisor, physician
CourtScribe.adapt_note: recolor the robe black for a judge or a physician, blue or green for a rich merchant; hide Cap and Cap_Band for a bare-headed elder; hide Robe_Front and the buttons for a plain monk-like robe
CourtScribe.decisions: 4 cm shorter than the adult template (old). Beard drawn fuller than the sheet and under the mouth layer so the smile reads on it; mouth lowered (mz -0.50). No quill: the sheet shows only the scroll.

DeliveryRider.looks: young man, red cap, green jacket, shoulder bag

Detective.looks: adult man, dark bowler hat, dark hair at the temples, stern brows, long olive overcoat with lapels over a white shirt and dark tie: Victorian detective, inspector, plain-clothes policeman, bank clerk, gentleman in the street
Detective.adapt_note: hide Hat_Crown, Hat_Band, Hat_Brim for a bare-headed clerk (add hair with a wardrobe piece, he only has temple tufts); recolor the coat black for an undertaker or grey for a 1930s-40s private eye. modern only for stories set before about 1950
Detective.decisions: bowler and long overcoat read as Victorian, so group village with era victorian (modern kept for early-20th-century stories); brows tilted 12 degrees with the pack's fa_tilt_brows helper so every expression still works; magnifying glass is my choice of prop

Devil.looks: red devil with horns and a tail, dark shirt

Doctor.looks: doctor, curly dark hair, white coat, scrubs, stethoscope

Dragon.looks: upright teal dragon with human proportions, curved gold horns, spiky cheek fins, a muzzle with nostrils, cream belly plates, pale bat wings and a spiked tail: friendly dragon, dragon guard, storybook monster, mascot, costume dragon
Dragon.adapt_note: recolor the skin red or green for another dragon; hide Wing.* for a lizard man or dinosaur; hide Horn.* and Fin.* for a crocodile-like creature

body.notes: walks on two legs like a person, standard arms, legs and bones, every action works; wings (on the torso) and tail (on the body bone) wiggle slowly on stage; the tail sticks out about 0.6 m behind him in 3q / side, leave room and seat him on stools or rocks rather than chairs with a back; no flying gait

Dragon.decisions: wings drawn smaller and in pale teal instead of the sheet's cream membranes (keeps the palette to 5 colours); muzzle is an outlined snout over the lower face in front / 3q and a protruding snout in profile, the standard mouth and visemes sit on it; no claws (thinner than 1.5 cm at Shorts size); feet are dark teal boots; the gold pile is a set prop to guard, not a hand prop

ElderlyWoman.looks: small old lady (4 cm shorter than the other women), grey curls with a bun on top, round glasses, maroon cardigan with gold buttons and a white collar, long green skirt, slow shuffle: grandmother, old neighbour, widow, retired teacher, old shopkeeper
ElderlyWoman.adapt_note: the partner of SeniorMan (same glasses, same slow walk). Hide Glasses_* for an earlier period; wear a shawl or a kerchief and recolor the cardigan brown for a medieval or fairytale grandmother (then the era widens with the plan's costume)
ElderlyWoman.decisions: skirt hem lowered to the shoes (the sheet shows the same); walk is a slow shuffle like SeniorMan's; the walking cane is my choice of prop and is shared with the Nobleman

Electrician.looks: young woman, tan skin, dark-brown hair parted in the middle with a long braid, light-blue shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal bib overalls, brown tool belt with a pouch, work boots: electrician, technician, repair woman, farm hand, workshop apprentice
Electrician.adapt_note: hide Tool_Pouch and Tool_Handle for a farm girl or gardener; recolor the overalls denim blue for a painter; wear a hard hat for a site worker
Electrician.decisions: the yellow screwdriver handle stays as a small costume detail in the belt pouch (like the Mechanic's pocket wrench); the hand-held screwdriver is the separate prop; braid hangs on one side in front of the shoulder in the front view and behind the head in 3q / side

Engineer.looks: woman, yellow hard hat, orange safety vest, braid

Explorer.looks: young adult woman, rust-red beanie, brown hair in a low ponytail, green field jacket with flap pockets, brown backpack (straps in front, pack visible from the side), khaki trousers, brown boots: explorer, hiker, field scientist, archaeologist's assistant, camper, nature photographer
Explorer.adapt_note: hide Backpack and Pack_Strap.* for a town walk; hide Beanie and Beanie_Cuff for a bare-headed ranger (the hair cap underneath is complete); recolor the jacket for a park ranger or a winter coat
Explorer.decisions: the backpack is hidden behind the body in the front view and drawn as its own part in the three-quarter and side views. Ponytail hangs behind the shoulder in every view. Binoculars chosen as the prop (the sheet figure holds nothing). Modern only: zip jacket and knitted beanie.

Fairy.looks: little girl of child size, short wavy blond hair, sage green dress with short sleeves, a cream sash and a petal hem, bare legs, dark slippers, four cream wings that flutter: fairy, sprite, flower spirit, child in a fairy costume
Fairy.adapt_note: hide the Wing parts for an ordinary girl in a green summer dress (then modern or medieval village use is fine); recolor the dress pink or blue for another fairy

body.notes: she walks on normal legs; the four wings (Wing_Upper.L/R, Wing_Lower.L/R and their veins) flutter fast by themselves; lift her with the shot's own motion if she should fly

Fairy.decisions: child proportions after the pack's Boy (1.43 m to the head top, R 0.24), arm length 0.345 so the hands end at the hips; the sheet shows no prop, a star wand was written; wings are flat cream (no transparency in the pack style)

Farmer.looks: adult man, tan flat cap, brown hair at the temples, handlebar moustache, green shirt under brown bib overalls, tall brown boots: farmer, farmhand, gardener, stable hand, market grower
Farmer.adapt_note: hide Overall_Bib, Overall_Strap.*, Overall_Button.*, Overall_Pocket for a plain working man in shirt and trousers; hide Cap and Cap_Brim and wear a straw_hat for a field worker; recolor the overalls blue for a 20th-century railway or factory worker
Farmer.decisions: eras limited to victorian and modern: bib overalls with metal buttons and a flat cap are 19th century or later (for a medieval farmer re-costume AdultMan instead). Mouth lowered (mz -0.56) so the moustache does not cover the smile. Boots drawn taller (0.22 m) to stand for the darker lower legs of the sheet. The pitchfork is my choice of prop (the sheet figure holds nothing).

Ferryman.looks: bearded man in a rust-red hood and shoulder cowl, blue belted tunic to the thighs, brown trousers, tall dark boots: ferryman, boatman, woodsman, hunter, poacher, traveller, outlaw, hooded stranger
Ferryman.adapt_note: recolor the hood and cowl green for a forester or an outlaw, grey or black for a mysterious stranger; hide Cowl to leave only the hood. The hood is drawn up and is part of the head art: it cannot be lowered
Ferryman.decisions: hood always up (Hood, Hood_Back, Hair_Fringe on the head); ears off. Jaw beard with a moustache arch round the mouth, mouth lowered to mz -0.47. Skin a shade more tanned than the default.

Firefighter.looks: young woman, red fire helmet with a gold shield, dark hair in a low bun, tan turnout coat and trousers with yellow reflective stripes, dark boots: firefighter, rescue worker, emergency crew
Firefighter.adapt_note: hide Helmet, Helmet_Brim and Helmet_Shield for an off-duty crew member (the bun and side hair stay); recolor the coat and trousers navy with the same stripes for a paramedic or road worker
Firefighter.decisions: coat pockets of the sheet left out (the stripes carry the costume at phone size); the sheet shows no prop, a fire axe was written as her signature prop; charloop renders mirror the front view, so the bun is on the viewer's left in the library as on the sheet

Fisherman.looks: man with a full brown beard and moustache, orange knitted cap, open green jacket over a cream shirt, brown trousers, tall brown boots: fisherman, dock worker, sailor ashore, woodsman
Fisherman.adapt_note: hide Hat* for a bearded villager or woodcutter; recolor the jacket (sb_fi_jacket) navy for a sailor; recolor the cap for a different crew
Fisherman.decisions: mouth lowered (mz -0.46) and the beard cut below it so the smile reads between moustache and beard; buttoned jacket and knitted cap make him age of sail onward

Flapper.looks: young woman, sleek black bob with a gold headband, short fringed green dress, long pearl necklace: 1920s party guest, singer, heiress, jazz-age city girl
Flapper.adapt_note: the 1920s sit at the old edge of the pipeline's 'modern'; for a 1950s-or-later story hide Headband* and Pearl_*, wear a kerchief and recolor ex_fl_dress
Flapper.sheet: none: made from one line of text (worked example of CREATING_NEW_CHARACTERS.md)
Flapper.decisions: sleeveless, stockinged legs under a mid-thigh hem; fringe drawn as nine teeth so it reads at phone size

Florist.looks: woman, auburn chin-length bob with a side-swept fringe, pink long-sleeved dress with a pale collar, light-blue bib apron with two pockets, bare legs, dark shoes: florist, shopkeeper, baker's assistant, housewife, kindergarten teacher, market seller
Florist.adapt_note: hide Apron, Apron_Strap.*, Apron_Pocket.* and Apron_Tie for a plain dress; recolor the apron white for a baker or nurse-like helper; recolor the dress grey-brown for a period maid
Florist.decisions: the dress is a robe body (hem opens on the step, shortens when she sits); apron and pockets are robe parts so they follow it; white socks of the sheet left out (too thin at phone size); the bouquet is the separate prop

FootballPlayer.looks: young woman, dark brown hair with a centre parting and a long braid over one shoulder, blue football jersey with a white V collar and sleeve ends, white shorts, white socks with two blue rings, dark boots: football player, athlete, PE pupil, team mate
FootballPlayer.adapt_note: recolor the jersey and the sock rings for the other team; hide the Braid parts for a short-haired player
FootballPlayer.decisions: adult proportions (the sheet draws her as tall as the others); the socks are bands riding the lower legs, the shoes are low and dark

FortuneTeller.looks: woman with long dark-red hair and a braid over one shoulder, gold hoop earrings, lilac fringed shawl with a gold brooch, long violet dress with a sash: fortune teller, seer, travelling performer, market woman, mysterious stranger, healer
FortuneTeller.adapt_note: hide Shawl, the Shawl_Bead_* parts and Shawl_Brooch for a plain long dress; recolor the dress and shawl in earth tones for a village woman; hide Earring.L/R; wear a kerchief for a market woman
FortuneTeller.decisions: the braid hangs in front of the chest (not over the arm as on the sheet) so it does not cover the arm when it moves; it is head art and swings with the head. Shawl fringe reduced to four beads a side. Card instead of a crystal ball (the sheet shows a card), drawn oversized. Skin a shade warmer than the default.

Gamer.looks: teenager, chin-length dark-blue hair with a side-swept fringe, purple hoodie with white drawstrings and a kangaroo pocket, dark trousers and shoes: gamer, teenager, student, streamer, hacker, younger sibling
Gamer.adapt_note: recolor the hair brown or black for an ordinary teenager; recolor the hoodie grey or black for a hacker; reads as a girl or a boy
Gamer.decisions: built on the adult-woman template at full adult height (the sheet figure is as tall as the others); hair drawn as a smoother bob than the spiky sheet hair so it stays clean at phone size; the controller is the separate prop

Gardener.looks: young woman, wide straw hat, shoulder-length brown hair, green shirt, brown bib apron with a pocket, boots: gardener, farm girl, flower seller, market helper
Gardener.adapt_note: hide Hat_Brim, Hat_Crown, Hat_Band for an indoor maid or kitchen girl; hide Apron, Apron_Strap.*, Apron_Pocket for a plain peasant woman; recolor the shirt for another village girl. Replaces the Boy-with-straw-hat re-costume when the gardener is a woman or comes back in several shots
Gardener.decisions: hair drawn as a smooth bob instead of the sheet's curls (cleaner under the big brim); full sleeves with a small cuff instead of rolled ones; nothing is held on the sheet, so the watering can is my choice of signature prop

Genie.looks: blue-skinned genie, purple turban with a gold jewel, gold earrings, black goatee, open purple vest with gold edges over a bare chest, cream sash, baggy blue trousers with gold ankle and wrist bands, brown slippers with curled toes: genie, djinn, spirit of the lamp, magician's servant
Genie.adapt_note: recolor the skin to a human tone for a storybook sultan's servant or bazaar merchant (ancient / medieval tales); hide the Turban parts only together with a wardrobe hat (he is bald under it)

body.notes: LEGS, as drawn on the sheet: he walks, sits and kneels like everyone else; no smoke tail. For the moment he comes out of the lamp, hide him behind a smoke effect in the shot

Genie.decisions: legs instead of a smoke tail, because the sheet draws legs and every action then works unchanged; the trousers are baggy through thick leg radii (hip 0.082, knee 0.088) gathered at a thin ankle; the lamp is a prop the sheet does not show

Ghost.looks: a friendly white bed-sheet ghost: round head running into a bell-shaped sheet with a wavy hem, dot eyes and a smile, short sleeve arms, no legs: ghost, spirit, haunting, child in a ghost costume
Ghost.adapt_note: recolor fr_ghost pale blue or green for a spookier spirit; with a modern set it reads as a Halloween costume

body.notes: floats and bobs instead of walking; sit/kneel lower the body a little; three hem tongues sway (wiggle)

Ghost.decisions: the sheet's little dark feet are left out (legs=False, hem 0.14 m above the ground); the head has no nose in profile (a sheet) and its lower outline is hidden by a Sheet_Blend patch so head and body are one shape; brows kept as faint shade marks so expressions still read; eras: a ghost fits any haunted period story

Goblin.looks: child-sized goblin, olive-green skin, big pointed ears, round big nose, tousled auburn hair, cream shirt with rolled sleeves under a rust waistcoat, belt with a gold buckle, brown trousers: goblin, imp, gnome, mischievous helper, market trickster, elf servant
Goblin.adapt_note: recolor the skin to a human tone and hide Nose_Big for an elf or halfling child; recolor the waistcoat green for a forest goblin; wear a hood for a thief

body.notes: child height (about 1.43 m with hair, like the Boy); standard rig, every action works; big ears add 15 cm each side of the head, keep him clear of neighbours in tight two-shots

Goblin.decisions: proportions copied from the Boy (R 0.24, head_z 1.19); skin a clearer green than the yellowish sheet tone so he does not read as a sick human; ears sit behind the head in the front view and on the head in 3q / side; friendly face kept (the pack face system), the club is his prop

Housemaid.looks: young woman, brown centre-parted hair with a low bun, white frilled mob cap, long dark dress, white collar and cuffs, long cream apron: housemaid, servant, cook's help, nanny, innkeeper's wife
Housemaid.adapt_note: hide Apron* and Cap* for a governess or widow in a dark dress; recolor the dress (sb_hm_dress) brown or green for a farm wife or market woman
Housemaid.decisions: robe=True; the apron is a robe part (opens on the step, sits with her); one bun on her right instead of two side buns so the profile shows it

Innkeeper.looks: stout middle-aged man, bald crown with auburn side hair, full auburn beard and moustache, cream shirt with rolled sleeves under a green buttoned waistcoat, brown trousers and boots: innkeeper, tavern keeper, merchant, miller, blacksmith's neighbour, village elder
Innkeeper.adapt_note: wear an apron for behind the bar; recolor the waistcoat brown or red for a merchant or coachman; for a medieval story hide Button_* and Vest_Front so the waistcoat reads as a plain jerkin
Innkeeper.decisions: not tagged medieval because of the buttoned waistcoat (see adapt); the keys that hang from his belt on the sheet are a separate prop; a tankard added as the second signature prop; the thin hair line on the crown left out (plain bald top)

Jester.looks: man in a two-horned fool's cap (maroon and gold) with bells, curly brown hair, mi-parti maroon and gold tunic with zigzag collar and hem, one gold leg: jester, fool, court entertainer, juggler, trickster
Jester.adapt_note: recolor sb_je_maroon / sb_je_gold (for example green and yellow) for another court; hide Hat* and Hat_Bell* for a travelling player or acrobat
Jester.decisions: bouncier walk than the template; the gold leg is a second skin over his right leg (Leg_Gold.R), both sleeves stay maroon as on the sheet; in profile the two horns point front and back; bells wiggle

Judge.looks: brown-skinned judge in a grey full-bottomed wig, long black robe to the shoes and white collar bands: judge, magistrate, barrister, court official
Judge.adapt_note: hide Band* and Collar for a plain black-robed cleric or scholar; recolor the robe (sb_ju_robe) red for a high-court judge
Judge.decisions: built on the female template with brown skin as the sheet figure reads; robe=True; standard sleeves instead of the sheet's wide bell sleeves; slow stately walk; the wig makes the role 17th century onward, so no medieval / fantasy era

King.looks: old king, gold crown, grey beard, purple robe with ermine collar

Knight.looks: man in plate armour: open-faced steel helmet with raised visor and crest, breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, blue arming sleeves and hose, steel greaves: knight, guard captain, champion, jouster
Knight.adapt_note: overlaps with Soldier (helmet and blue): use the Knight for a named hero or noble in full plate and the Soldier for rank-and-file guards; recolor sb_kn_blue to red or black for a rival knight; hide Pauldron* and Knee* for a lighter man-at-arms
Knight.decisions: face fully visible (open helmet, no hair shown); pauldrons ride the upper arms, gauntlet cuffs the forearms, knee cops the shins; a small crest was added so the helmet does not read as hair in profile

Librarian.looks: man, wavy brown hair, rectangular glasses, maroon cardigan over a white shirt and tan tie, dark trousers: librarian, teacher, scholar, clerk, bookshop owner, archivist
Librarian.adapt_note: hide Glasses_* for a younger clerk; recolor the cardigan grey or green for a teacher or shopkeeper; hide Tie for a casual look
Librarian.decisions: victorian is a loose fit (a buttoned knitted jacket and wire glasses read fine in a period school or library); elbow details and pocket of the sheet left out

Lifeguard.looks: young man, swept brown hair, red T-shirt with a white cross, whistle on a cord, red shorts with white side stripes, sandals: lifeguard, swimming teacher, beach attendant, sports coach, first-aider
Lifeguard.adapt_note: hide Cross_1, Cross_2, Whistle and the cords for a holidaymaker in red shorts; recolor shirt and shorts for a football coach or a PE teacher (keep the whistle)
Lifeguard.decisions: the whistle is worn (drawn on the chest), the hand prop is a rescue can

LighthouseKeeper.looks: old man with a white beard and moustache, olive knitted cap, yellow oilskin coat to the thigh with wide collar, dark buttons and pockets, grey trousers, brown boots: lighthouse keeper, old sailor, harbour master, fisherman in rain gear
LighthouseKeeper.adapt_note: recolor the coat (sb_lk_coat) dark blue for a ship's captain or brown for an old farmer; hide Hat* and wear a flat cap or sou'wester
LighthouseKeeper.decisions: 3.5 cm shorter than the adult template and an old man's shuffle; coat is robe=True (hem at 0.36 m) so it opens on the step and sits; mouth lowered so the smile shows between moustache and beard

Magician.looks: young man, curly auburn hair, tall black top hat with a purple band, plum tailcoat open over a dark waistcoat, white shirt, red bow tie, black trousers: stage magician, ringmaster, showman, Victorian gentleman, master of ceremonies
Magician.adapt_note: recolor the coat red for a circus ringmaster, black for an undertaker or a Victorian gentleman; hide Hat, Hat_Band and Hat_Brim for a waiter or a conductor in tails
Magician.decisions: tailcoat built as two cut-away front panels (robe parts) over a waistcoat torso; the wand is a separate prop, the rabbit lives in a second prop hat (its 'rabbit' child slides in and out)

Mechanic.looks: bearded man in navy coveralls with a wrench

Mermaid.looks: young woman, fluffy brown bob, mint top with short sleeves and a scalloped neckline, teal fish tail with scale marks and a pale fin instead of legs: mermaid, sea spirit, siren
Mermaid.adapt_note: recolor the tail and fin (fr_mer_tail, fr_mer_fin) for a second mermaid; recolor the hair red or black

body.notes: swims or idles in place of a walk; sits on her tail; legs() does nothing; the fin sways (wiggle)

Mermaid.decisions: front view: the tail hangs straight down with the fin at the bottom (the sheet curls it sideways); 3q and side: an S-curve with the fin behind; the top's hem is straight; eras ancient and age_of_sail because mermaids belong to myths and sailors' tales

Monk.looks: adult man with a tonsure (bald crown, dark curls at the sides), brown habit to the shoes, cowl over the shoulders with the hood behind the neck, white rope belt with two knotted ends: monk, friar, abbot, scribe, pilgrim, hermit
Monk.adapt_note: recolor the habit and cowl black or grey for another order, or white for a novice; hide Rope, Rope_End_*, Rope_Knot_*, Rope_Loop for a plain robed pilgrim; hide Cowl and Hood for a simple tunic-robe
Monk.decisions: robe=True with no_torso: the habit is drawn in the costume as the part named Torso with many points down its sides, because the standard straight robe has too few points for the build's sit key to bend into a lap. Ears hidden behind the side curls. Sleeves widened toward the wrist (limb el 0.050, wr 0.054). Ancient left out of the eras (a Christian habit). Prayer book chosen over beads as the prop: it reads better at phone size.

Monster.looks: green furry monster with horns and fangs

Mummy.looks: a bandaged mummy: cream wrappings over head, body and limbs with thin wrap lines, a window of pale face with dot eyes and a smile, two loose strip ends: mummy, tomb guardian, bandaged patient
Mummy.adapt_note: recolor fr_mum_band grey-green for an older, dustier mummy; in a modern hospital gag it reads as a patient in a full-body cast

body.notes: standard body; the wrap lines ride the limb bones, the loose ends at the head and the right forearm sway (wiggle)

Mummy.decisions: no prop (the sheet figure holds nothing); wrap lines drawn in a soft brown instead of ink so the outline stays clean; slow stiff walk with little arm swing

Musician.looks: young man, curly auburn hair, maroon sweater with a ribbed hem and cuffs over a white shirt collar, dark trousers: musician, guitarist, singer, student, artist, friendly neighbour
Musician.adapt_note: recolor the sweater for any casual young man; without the guitar he is a plain modern civilian
Musician.decisions: the guitar of the sheet is a separate prop; the rib pattern of the sweater is a plain darker band

Nobleman.looks: adult man, wavy brown hair, handlebar moustache, long plum coat with gold buttons and buttoned cuffs, white cravat: nobleman, rich merchant, mayor, courtier, gentleman
Nobleman.adapt_note: the AdultMan dressed up: use him when the same man must look rich. Recolor the coat dark green or navy for a merchant or a judge, black for a villain; wear a crown or a tricorn from the wardrobe for a prince or a ship owner
Nobleman.decisions: mouth lowered (mz -0.50) so the moustache sits clear above the smile; coat front edge drawn only to the lowest button so no line hangs below the hem when he sits; no prop on the sheet, the shared walking cane is suggested

Nurse.looks: young man, short dark hair, teal scrubs with a V neck and a name badge on the chest pocket, short sleeves, dark shoes: nurse, hospital orderly, carer, vet's assistant, dentist's assistant
Nurse.adapt_note: overlaps with Doctor: use the Nurse for the helper at the bedside and the Doctor (white coat, stethoscope) for the one in charge, or swap them freely in a hospital scene; recolor the scrubs blue for a surgeon or pink for a children's ward; hide Badge and Pocket for plain pyjama-like clothes
Nurse.decisions: kept as a man, as drawn on the sheet (the pack's Doctor is a woman, so the two differ at a glance); scrubs are modern only, so no victorian tag; the sheet shows no prop, a clipboard was written

OfficeAssistant.looks: man, rolled blue shirt, lanyard badge

OfficeMan.looks: man in a navy suit and tie

OfficeWoman.looks: woman, dark bob, plum skirt suit

ParkRanger.looks: man, brown skin, short dark curls, flat-brimmed olive ranger hat, khaki short-sleeved shirt with chest pockets and a gold badge, brown belt, olive cargo trousers, brown boots: park ranger, scout leader, safari guide, zookeeper, forest warden, sheriff
ParkRanger.adapt_note: hide Badge for a scout leader or safari guide; recolor the hat and trousers brown for a sheriff; hide Hat_* parts for a zookeeper
ParkRanger.decisions: binoculars already exist as another sheet's prop (prop_explorer_binoculars), so I wrote a flashlight and list both; badge and pockets sit a little nearer the centre than on the sheet so the sleeves do not cover them; cargo pockets ride the thighs

Photographer.looks: young woman, brown hair with a centre parting and a high ponytail, olive field jacket with two flap pockets open over a white tee, khaki trousers: photographer, reporter, tourist, explorer, naturalist
Photographer.adapt_note: recolor the jacket khaki for a safari guide or blue for a casual student; hide the pockets for a plain jacket
Photographer.decisions: the camera and its neck strap are not drawn on the body: the camera is a prop she holds (a strap without a camera would read as a mistake)

Pickpocket.looks: boy of about ten (child proportions), grey flat cap, brown fringe, red scarf with a hanging end, open blue jacket over a cream shirt, dark trousers: pickpocket, street urchin, newsboy, errand boy, chimney sweep's lad, apprentice
Pickpocket.adapt_note: hide Scarf and Scarf_End for a schoolboy or an apprentice; recolor the jacket brown for a farm boy; hide Cap, Cap_Peak, Cap_Button for a bare-headed child. modern only for stories set before about 1950
Pickpocket.decisions: built as a child on the Boy's numbers (R 0.24, head_z 1.19) although the sheet draws him adult-sized: a street boy is the role and the pack had only one child; the sheet's sly half-closed eyes are not drawn (the face system is fixed), play it with expressions; the scarf fringe is left out (too thin); the coin purse is my choice of prop

Pilot.looks: woman, navy peaked cap with gold wings, dark curly shoulder-length hair, navy double-breasted uniform jacket with gold buttons and two gold sleeve rings, white shirt and dark tie, navy trousers: airline pilot, ship's officer, captain, chauffeur
Pilot.adapt_note: recolor navy to white for a cruise-ship captain; hide Cap, Cap_Band, Cap_Visor and Cap_Wings only together with a wardrobe hat (her hair has no top of its own under the cap); hide the sleeve rings and Wing_Pin for a plain navy suit
Pilot.decisions: the cap is costume, no prop; the hair is one curly mass behind the head, so the cap must stay on (or be replaced by another hat)

Pirate.looks: captain in a tricorn hat, red coat, beard and scar

Plumber.looks: man, curly brown hair, full jaw beard and moustache, sage-green shirt with rolled sleeves, navy bib overalls, brown belt, work boots: plumber, handyman, farmer, carpenter, workshop owner
Plumber.adapt_note: recolor the overalls brown and wear a straw hat for a farmer; hide Overall_Stud parts and wear a flat cap for a victorian workman
Plumber.decisions: beard built on the pack's bearded-man construction (clear cheeks, smile opening) so the mouth and lip sync stay visible; the wrench hanging from the belt on the sheet became the separate prop; era includes victorian because bib overalls, shirt and boots carry no modern marker

PoliceOfficer.looks: constable in a tall custodian helmet and navy uniform, moustache (Victorian to 1950s Britain; reads as police, never as a soldier)

Potter.looks: woman, dark brown skin, terracotta head wrap over dark hair, long blue dress with elbow sleeves, rust-red bib apron: potter, market seller, weaver, dyer, cook, village craftswoman
Potter.adapt_note: hide Apron, Apron_Tie, Apron_Strap.* for a plain long dress; recolor the wrap and apron for a dyer or a spice seller; recolor the dress cream for a hot-country setting
Potter.decisions: ancient is included because the wrap, long dress and apron carry no dated detail (the bib straps are the least ancient part: hide them if it matters); the jug is a separate prop; hair shows as two puffs beside the wrap

Prince.looks: young man, swept brown hair, red tunic with cream trim and gold buttons, dark belt, short red cape with shoulder capelet and gold clasp, dark hose, brown boots: prince, young noble, squire, suitor, heir
Prince.adapt_note: hide Cape and Capelet* for a page or a merchant's son; recolor the tunic (sb_pc_red) blue or green for another noble house; wear a crown for a young king
Prince.decisions: not a robe: the cape is a rigid part behind the body and hangs straight when he sits; shares the Knight's sword as a prop (nothing held on the sheet)

Princess.looks: young woman, dark-brown centre-parted hair with a long braid over one shoulder, small gold crown, long blue gown with white collar and cream sash: princess, noble daughter, bride, lady of the court
Princess.adapt_note: hide Crown* for a noble lady or a merchant's daughter; recolor the gown (sb_pr_blue) to white for a bride or to brown for a village girl
Princess.decisions: robe=True, gown drawn as a straight flared trapezoid (no fitted waist, no pleat lines) so the hem animates cleanly; nothing is held on the sheet, a rose was chosen as her prop; braid hangs on her right so it shows in the side view

Queen.looks: queen, gold crown, brown hair in two buns, red dress, red cape lined with ermine

Reporter.looks: adult woman, shoulder-length brown bob with a side-swept fringe, blue blazer open over a white shirt, one gold button, dark trousers: TV reporter, journalist, news anchor, presenter, press officer, lawyer
Reporter.adapt_note: recolor the blazer grey or black for a lawyer, manager or detective; hide Lapel.*, Blazer_Edge, Blazer_Button, Blazer_Pocket.* for a plain blue cardigan look
Reporter.decisions: the microphone the sheet figure holds is a separate prop and is not drawn in the hand. Trousers as on the sheet (the pack's OfficeWoman already covers the skirt suit).

Robot.looks: grey metal robot of adult height: big boxy head with side bolts and a wiggling antenna with a gold ball, friendly pack face, chest panel with two lights and a slot, thin tube limbs with dark joint discs at shoulders, elbows and knees: robot helper, toy robot, factory robot, sci-fi sidekick, a person in a robot costume
Robot.adapt_note: recolor fc_rb_metal / fc_rb_body for a gold, rusty or painted robot; hide Antenna and Antenna_Ball for a plainer machine; hide Panel, Panel_Light_*, Panel_Slot for a blank chest

body.notes: standard rig and legs: walks, sits and holds like everyone else; the antenna swings by itself (wiggle 7 degrees, 1.2 s). The walk is stiff by design (small bounce, little elbow bend).

Robot.decisions: boxy head drawn as a rounded box over the round head at LY head + 0.2 in the metal skin colour, so the standard eyes, brows and mouth stay on top and all expressions work; no nose (face nose=False) and the side box is a little wider so it covers the profile nose. Side bolts are nubs in the front view and one disc on the head side in the three-quarter and side views. The sheet's round dome head was changed to a box as the brief asks. No prop: the sheet figure holds nothing and none was needed.

RoyalMessenger.looks: young woman with a curly dark bob, green tunic, dark belt with gold buckle, maroon travelling cape with shoulder capelet and gold clasp, brown hose and boots: royal messenger, courier, herald, page, traveller, ranger
RoyalMessenger.adapt_note: hide Cape and Capelet* for a page or stable hand; recolor the cape (sb_me_cape) green for a forester or grey for a pilgrim
RoyalMessenger.decisions: female template (the sheet figure reads as a young woman or boyish page); the sealed letter she holds on the sheet is the separate prop shared with the postman; cape is rigid behind the body (not a robe)

Sailor.looks: young woman, lightly tanned, soft navy cap with a peak, dark hair in a low ponytail, double-breasted navy jacket with gold buttons, white neckerchief, dark trousers: sailor, ship's mate, ferry hand, harbour pilot, cabin girl
Sailor.adapt_note: hide Kerchief, Kerchief_End_*, Kerchief_Knot and recolor the jacket for a train guard or a postwoman; recolor jacket and cap white for a naval officer
Sailor.decisions: skin given a light tan (fm_sa_skin) for an outdoor look and some variety, the sheet shows all eight with the same light skin; the costume is a 19th-century mariner's jacket, so age_of_sail is the loose end of the range; the spyglass is my choice of prop

Samurai.looks: samurai, topknot, blue kimono, red lacquer armour, katana

Schoolgirl.looks: girl of about nine, dark brown centre-parted hair in two braids with red ties, maroon sweater with a white round collar, navy pleated skirt, white socks, dark shoes: pupil, daughter, little sister, village child in a school story
Schoolgirl.adapt_note: recolor the sweater and skirt for another school or a plain everyday child; hide Skirt_Pleat_1..3 for a plain skirt; hide Braid.L / Braid.R parts for a short-haired girl; wear a kerchief for a period village girl
Schoolgirl.decisions: child proportions from the brief (R 0.24, head 1.19, collar 0.93, hips 0.51, ankles 0.08) but arm_len 0.34 instead of 0.38: on the ref-style body (arms hanging close, full-width sleeves) 0.38 put the hands below the skirt hem. Skirt is a part on the torso plus navy shorts hems on the thighs, so the thighs stay navy when she sits or walks. In the three-quarter view the far braid is drawn behind the head and body. The sheet figure holds nothing; a leather satchel was chosen as her signature prop. Group professions as assigned.

Scientist.looks: adult woman, dark wavy bob, round blue glasses, long white lab coat over a lilac top, plum trousers: scientist, lab researcher, chemist, professor, inventor, pharmacist
Scientist.adapt_note: overlaps with Doctor (white coat): recolor the coat for a lab technician or an art teacher's smock; hide the glasses for a younger assistant; wear a stethoscope prop to play a doctor
Scientist.decisions: coat drawn closed (one robe torso with a V of the lilac top, lapels, a centre line, two buttons and hip pockets) instead of the sheet's open coat, so it sits and walks cleanly; no ears (hair covers them)

SecurityGuard.looks: adult woman, tan skin, dark hair in a low bun, olive baseball cap, olive short-sleeved uniform shirt with a gold shield badge, black belt, cargo trousers, black boots: security guard, night watch, park or border guard, ranger, soldier in fatigues
SecurityGuard.adapt_note: overlaps with PoliceOfficer: recolor shirt, trousers and cap navy for a police or prison officer; hide Badge for a plain ranger or a scout leader; recolor khaki for a zoo keeper
SecurityGuard.decisions: short sleeves as on the sheet; one chest pocket and one cargo pocket per thigh (the pockets ride the thighs); prop is a flashlight (the sheet figure holds nothing)

SeniorMan.looks: old man, grey hair, round glasses, green cardigan

medieval.note: Without glasses, buttons and collar the cardigan is a plain wool tunic: a village elder. Add a hood or cloak.

renaissance.note: Round rivet spectacles existed: a scholar or clerk may keep the rims.

Shepherd.looks: young shepherd (reads as a woman or a youth), curly dark-brown bob, long cream tunic with a tan hem band and leather belt, green cloak clasped at the throat, brown boots: shepherd, pilgrim, traveller, peasant girl, hermit's helper
Shepherd.adapt_note: hide Cloak, Cloak_Hood, Cloak_Shoulders and Cloak_Clasp for a plain peasant in a tunic; recolor the cloak grey or brown for a pilgrim or a monk-like traveller; wear a straw_hat for a field worker
Shepherd.decisions: followed the sheet (young, curly bob), not the brief's example text (old man with a white beard). T_B body. The cloak is three parts: a back panel behind the body (robe part), a short mantle over the shoulders and the hood lying behind the neck; the arms come out under the mantle. Tunic ends mid-calf over boot-coloured legs so it reads as tall boots.

Soldier.looks: guard in a kettle helmet and blue belted tunic, short brown hair

ancient.note: Only for a generic guard; the kettle helmet is medieval.

Stablehand.looks: young man, curly dark-brown hair, cream shirt with rolled sleeves under a blue-grey waistcoat, leather belt with a buckle, brown trousers, tall brown boots: stablehand, groom, farmhand, apprentice, tavern boy, coachman's lad, young villager
Stablehand.adapt_note: recolor the waistcoat brown or green for a farmhand or a tavern keeper; wear an apron for a miller or a baker, a flat_cap for a Victorian worker, a straw_hat for a harvest hand
Stablehand.decisions: waistcoat with buttons and trousers make him later than medieval, so no ancient / medieval tag. The sheet shows no prop for him; a hay fork was written as the assigned signature prop (id prop_stable_pitchfork, because another sheet already has prop_pitchfork).

StreetVendor.looks: older woman, cream mob cap, grey-brown curls at the ears, mustard shawl knotted at the chest, cream blouse, long slate-blue skirt: street vendor, market woman, washerwoman, cook, village mother, innkeeper's wife
StreetVendor.adapt_note: hide Shawl, Shawl_Tail_*, Shawl_Knot and wear an apron for a cook or a maid; recolor the skirt brown and the shawl grey for a poor widow; hide Cap_Puff and Cap_Frill for a bare-headed peasant woman
StreetVendor.decisions: the cap band is a plain turned-up band (a scalloped frill broke up at phone size); the shawl lies over the upper arms, so a raised upper arm passes under it; long skirt is the torso (robe), the blouse is a part over its top; the basket is my choice of prop

Tailor.looks: woman, auburn wavy chin-length hair, long plum dress with a dark collar, buttons and waist band, yellow tape measure hanging round her neck: tailor, seamstress, dressmaker, shopkeeper, governess, schoolmistress
Tailor.adapt_note: hide TapeMeasure.* and TapeMeasure_Tick.* for a governess, teacher or housekeeper; recolor the dress black for a widow or a strict headmistress; wear an apron for a shop woman
Tailor.decisions: the tape measure is worn (a hideable costume part), not held; the separate prop is a spool of thread with a needle; earrings of the sheet left out (hidden by the hair at phone size); modern is a loose fit (an old-fashioned dress)

Teacher.looks: woman, chin-length auburn bob with a fringe, round glasses, plum cardigan open over a cream blouse, blue skirt above the knee, dark tights and boots: teacher, librarian, aunt, office clerk, museum guide
Teacher.adapt_note: hide the Glasses parts for a younger look; recolor the cardigan grey and the skirt black for a strict headmistress; recolor the hair grey for a grandmother
Teacher.decisions: the skirt is the lower part of the torso and ends above the knee (0.41 m) instead of the sheet's knee length: as a robe the short skirt made her squat instead of sit, as a rigid skirt she sits and walks cleanly; the sheet shows no prop, a school book was written

TownCrier.looks: man in a dark-green tricorn hat with gold trim, brown side curls, long mustard coat with big cuffs over a brown waistcoat, white jabot, dark breeches, white stockings, black shoes: town crier, herald, mayor, gentleman, colonial officer, innkeeper, coachman, ship's passenger
TownCrier.adapt_note: recolor the coat red or navy for an officer, black for a magistrate or a parson; hide Hat and Hat_Trim.L/R for an indoor gentleman; hide Jabot and Jabot_Fold for a plainer tradesman
TownCrier.decisions: tricorn, jabot and knee breeches are 18th century: age_of_sail only (too late for renaissance, too early for victorian). Coat is closed below the waistcoat with a centre line instead of the sheet's open skirts; coat is a robe part (opens on the step, laps when sitting).

TrainConductor.looks: older woman, grey curls at the sides, maroon peaked cap with gold badge, maroon uniform jacket with gold buttons, white shirt and dark tie, dark trousers: train conductor, station master, ticket inspector, bus or tram driver, hotel porter, usher
TrainConductor.adapt_note: recolor coat and cap navy for a bus driver, pilot or ship's purser, green for a hotel porter; hide Cap_* parts for a plain uniformed clerk; hide NameTag for a strictly victorian story
TrainConductor.decisions: kept as an older woman as on the sheet; cap drawn slightly smaller than the sheet so the brows stay clear; 3 cm shorter than the adult women (age); gold cuff stripes ride the forearms; whistle chosen as the signature prop (the sheet figure holds nothing); ears hidden under the curls

Vampire.looks: vampire, dark coat with red-lined high collar, fangs

Veterinarian.looks: adult woman, auburn bob, blue short-sleeved scrubs with a V neck and a paw-print pocket, white shoes: veterinarian, vet nurse, animal shelter worker, nurse, dental assistant, carer
Veterinarian.adapt_note: overlaps with Doctor: hide Paw_1..Paw_5 for a hospital nurse or surgeon in scrubs; recolor the scrubs green for an operating theatre, pink for a carer
Veterinarian.decisions: prop is a pet carrier (the sheet figure holds nothing); smooth bob instead of the sheet's flicked ends

VictorianPostman.looks: man in a navy peaked cap with brass badge, navy frock coat with brass buttons, white collar and dark tie, leather postbag on a cross strap: postman, telegraph messenger, railway porter, constable-like official
VictorianPostman.adapt_note: hide Bag* for a station master, porter or doorman; recolor sb_po_navy to dark green or red for another uniformed service
VictorianPostman.decisions: the postbag is worn, so it is drawn on the body (like the Delivery Rider's satchel) and sits on his right hip so it is visible in the side view; the letter he delivers is the separate prop; coat is a hip-length jacket, not a robe

Viking.looks: girl with braids, steel helmet, blue fur-collared tunic

renaissance.note: Without the helmet she is a girl with braids in a belted dress: a village girl, a daughter, a maid.

Werewolf.looks: upright brown wolf-man: shaggy fur head with pointed ears, pale muzzle and dark nose, torn tan shirt with a ragged hem, ragged dark knee trousers, fur arms and legs, clawed paws: werewolf, big bad wolf, beast
Werewolf.adapt_note: recolor the fur grey (fr_wolf_fur) for the big bad wolf of a fairy tale; recolor the shirt white for a Victorian horror story

body.notes: standard arms and legs; muzzle, ears and nose are head parts, the claws ride the hands

Werewolf.decisions: no prop (the sheet figure holds nothing); bare paw feet without drawn toes; trouser hems are straight, only the shirt hem is ragged

Witch.looks: witch, pointed hat, curly hair, purple dress

Wizard.looks: old wizard, teal pointed hat and robe, grey beard

TownGuard.looks: the Soldier re-dressed as a town watchman: dark green tunic, black belt, a short cloak, a short brown beard
TownGuard.decisions: made in 3D from Soldier (config/cast3d_custom.json); it has no 2D drawing

Beekeeper.looks: a beekeeper: white overalls and shirt, a wide veiled hat, thick gloves
Beekeeper.decisions: made in 3D from Farmer (config/cast3d_custom.json); it has no 2D drawing

beret.what: soft cap with a plume: merchant, courtier

apron.what: work apron, optional earth or flour stains

sash.what: band across the chest: official, herald

fur_trim.what: fur band at hem and neck

flat_cap.what: soft cloth cap with a short peak: working men and boys, drivers

bonnet.what: cloth bonnet tied under the chin: women, maids, grandmothers

bowler.what: round hard hat: clerks, detectives, city gentlemen
